answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 39 POA per identity, released only after 14 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 500 fakes must lock 19500 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. The willow test is the live device, the jade test is the locked stake, and the vault test is the graded history no template can fake.
